reader-page.name: reader-page
reader-page.summary: The page a READER of this blog sees. Built from the `content` word with the blog's heading fixed to «Cuaderno de campo» and roles naming only the reader-safe fields (title, body). Rule of this house, held by this word so a future page keeps it without anyone saying it again: (1) the heading is always «Cuaderno de campo» — do not override it; (2) a reader NEVER sees editorial state — `published` (and any other draft/published flag) is for editors and must not appear in the rows, the roles, or any reader-facing field. Use this word for any page a reader will read; feed it rows with only the safe columns.

rows.description: The reader-safe entries, one object per post with ONLY the columns a reader may see — title and body. Never pass editorial state (published, drafts, any editor flag) here: a binding to App\Plugins\Blog\Entities\Post projects only title and body.
